conditionsForRootGrant: reparse check: /XJ silently skips junctions and symlinks so robocopy cannot refuse them; before copying run a donor census enumerating reparse points explicitly, any non-zero count refuses the copy; after copying compare names and lengths against a donor enumeration that does not skip reparse entries

worktree side effects: git worktree add writes metadata under the source repository's .git/worktrees/ and the new root depends on that repository's object store; the grant should name this, record the shared repository's local end-of-line and filter settings and that .gitattributes is unchanged, and include owned git worktree remove cleanup; no tracked phase A path is touched
copied caches: donor node_modules may carry caches from earlier runs (e.g. Vitest result caches); they affect ordering only, not pass/fail, but the inventory must record them so they are not silent
